title: ЭЕШ English mock 2024 · Mock 4
subject: English
theme: A television hoax, glaciers and a job interview
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.
note: Follows the 2024 ЭЕШ Variant A, known only from screenshots of a user upload on Scribd, not an official БҮТ file (the official key upload was deleted). Part I 47 items / 80 points, Part II 3 tasks / 20 points. No duration is printed, so durationMinutes is null.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Choose the most suitable word to complete each sentence. /6x1=6 points/

questions.stem: I've got ___ homework tonight, so I can't go out.
questions.explanation: “homework” тоологдохгүй нэр үг тул “many”, “a few”, “few” тохирохгүй; “so I can't go out” гэсэн нь даалгавар их байгааг заах тул “a lot of” (их) орно.

questions.stem: Nobody called while I was out, ___?
questions.explanation: “Nobody” үгүйсгэх утгатай тул хавсралт асуулт эерэг хэлбэртэй байх ба хүнийг заасан “nobody” хавсралтад “they”-ээр орлогддог тул “did they” болно.

questions.stem: It's starting to rain. You ___ take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: “had better” + “to”-гүй инфинитив нь сануулга, зөвлөгөө илэрхийлдэг: “It's starting to rain” тул шүхэр авсан нь дээр; “would better”, “should to” гэсэн хэлбэр байдаггүй.

questions.stem: I forgot ___ my homework, so the teacher was angry.
questions.explanation: “forget” + инфинитив нь хийх ёстой зүйлээ мартаж хийгээгүй гэсэн утгатай; даалгавраа авчраагүйгээс “the teacher was angry” тул “to bring” орно, “bringing” бол хийснээ мартах.

questions.stem: She sings ___ an angel.
questions.explanation: Хэн нэгэнтэй адилтгахдаа нэр үгийн өмнө “like” (…шиг) хэрэглэнэ: сахиусан тэнгэр шиг дуулдаг; “as an angel” гэвэл сахиусан тэнгэрийн хувиар гэсэн өөр утгатай болно.

questions.stem: We have a ___ table in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: Материал заасан “wooden” нэр үгтэй хамгийн ойр, түүний өмнө өнгө “brown”, түүнээс өмнө хэлбэр “round”, хамгийн эхэнд хэмжээ “large” ордог тул “large round brown wooden”.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the word or phrase that best completes each sentence. /7x2=14 points/

questions.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, we ___ the picnic.
questions.explanation: “tomorrow” гэсэн бодит, биелэх магадлалтай нөхцөл тул 1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр: “If” хэсэгт одоо энгийн цаг, гол хэсэгт “will” + үйл үг орж “rains / will cancel” болно; “If it will rain” гэж хэлдэггүй.

questions.stem: I applied to three universities, all of ___ accepted me.
questions.explanation: “three universities” нь байгууллага тул “all of” гэсэн угтвар үгийн дараа харьцангуй төлөөний үг “which” орно; “whom” хүнд хэрэглэгдэж, “them” орвол хоёр өгүүлбэр холбоос үггүй нийлнэ.

questions.stem:
"Why did you leave your last job?" the interviewer asked.
The interviewer asked ___.

options.A: me why I had left my last job
options.B: me why had I left my last job
options.C: why did I leave my last job
options.D: me why I leave my last job
options.E: me why you had left your last job

questions.explanation: Шууд бус асуултад “Why did you leave” гэсэн асуултын дараалал хүүрнэх болж, өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг өнгөрсөн төгссөн цаг болно; “you”, “your” нь “I”, “my” болох тул “me why I had left my last job”.

questions.stem: She got the job ___ her lack of experience.
questions.explanation: “her lack of experience” гэсэн нэр үгийн хэллэгийн өмнө угтвар үг “in spite of” (…-ийг үл харгалзан) орно; “even though”, “although” бол бүтэн өгүүлбэр шаарддаг.

questions.stem: I ___ at the optician's yesterday.
questions.explanation: Нүдээ өөрөө бус нүдний эмчид шалгуулсан тул үйлдүүлэх хэв хэрэглэх ба “yesterday” гэсэн тул өнгөрсөн цагаар “had my eyes tested” болно; “had tested my eyes” бол өнгөрсөн төгссөн цаг.

questions.stem: When I ___ home, my parents ___ dinner without me.
questions.explanation: Гэртээ ирэхэд эцэг эх аль хэдийн хоолоо идчихсэн байсан тул өмнө болсон үйлд өнгөрсөн төгссөн цаг ордог: “got / had already eaten”; “When I … home” хэсэг өнгөрсөн энгийн цагтай байна.

questions.stem: One day ___ young man walked ___ the forest and found a cave ___ the hill.
questions.explanation: “young” гийгүүлэгч авиагаар эхэлдэг тул “a” орно; ойн дундуур нэвтрэн алхахыг “through”, толгод дээрх агуйг “on” илэрхийлдэг тул бүхэлдээ “a / through / on”.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Read the short conversation and choose the appropriate response. There are two extra. /3x2=6 points/
tasks.text:
Oyun: I'm so nervous about my job interview tomorrow.
Bat: 14. _________ Mine is at ten o'clock.
Oyun: I don't really know what to wear.
Bat: 15. _________ Maybe we should ask my sister.
Oyun: Do you think they'll ask difficult questions?
Bat: 16. _________ But we've practised a lot.

questions.explanation: Оюун “I'm so nervous about my job interview tomorrow.” гэж “am”-тай эерэг өгүүлбэр хэлсэн тул Бат “So am I.” гэж санал нийлнэ; “Mine is at ten o'clock” гэсэн нь түүнд ч ярилцлага байгааг харуулна.
Оюун “I don't really know what to wear.” гэж одоо энгийн цагийн үгүйсгэх өгүүлбэр хэлсэн тул Бат “Nor do I.” гэж санал нийлнэ; дараа нь эгчээсээ асуухыг санал болгосон.
“Do you think they'll ask difficult questions?” гэсэн асуултад таагүй хариуг харамсалтайгаар батлахдаа “I'm afraid so.” гэдэг; “But we've practised a lot” гэж тайвшруулжээ.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the best options that transformed correctly using the KEY WORDS IN BOLD. /2x3=6 points/

questions.stem:
She started working here in 2020.
**since**

options.D: She has been worked here since 2020.

questions.explanation: 2020 онд эхэлж одоо ч ажиллаж байгаа тул эхэлсэн цэгийг заах “since”-тэй одоо төгссөн цаг хэрэглэнэ: “She has worked here since 2020.”; “has been worked” нь үйлдэгдэх хэв тул буруу.

questions.stem:
"Don't be late," the teacher told us.
**not**

options.A: The teacher said us not to be late.
options.B: The teacher told us to not being late.
options.C: The teacher told us don't be late.
options.D: The teacher told us not to be late.
options.E: The teacher told not us to be late.

questions.explanation: “Don't be late” гэсэн тушаалыг шууд бус ярианд “told” + хүн + “not to” + үйл үгээр дамжуулна: “The teacher told us not to be late.”; “said us” гэж хэлдэггүй.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct word to complete each sentence. /4x1=4 points/

questions.stem: Small balls of ice that fall from the sky are called ___.
questions.explanation: Тэнгэрээс унадаг жижиг мөсөн бөмбөлгүүдийг “hail” (мөндөр) гэнэ; “dew” нь шүүдэр, “mist” нь нимгэн манан.

questions.stem: A ___ writes articles for a newspaper.
questions.explanation: Сонинд нийтлэл бичдэг хүн бол “journalist” (сэтгүүлч); “librarian” нь номын санч, “cashier” нь кассчин.

questions.stem: ___ is the study of how the human mind works.
questions.explanation: “how the human mind works” буюу хүний сэтгэхүйг судалдаг шинжлэх ухаан бол “Psychology” (сэтгэл судлал); “Archaeology” нь эртний эд өлгийн зүйлсээр түүхийг судалдаг.

questions.stem: I filled ___ the application form and sent it.
questions.explanation: Маягт, анкет бөглөхийг “fill in” хэлц үйл үгээр илэрхийлдэг тул “in” орно; “the application form and sent it” гэсэн нь бөглөөд илгээснийг харуулна.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the word with different meanings that best fits in all three gaps. /3x1=3 points/
tasks.text:
23. I got a new _________ for my birthday; it tells the time and counts my steps.
24. Let's _________ a film tonight.
25. Could you _________ my bag for a minute while I buy a ticket?

questions.explanation: “it tells the time and counts my steps” гэсэн нь цаг харуулж, алхам тоолдог бугуйн цагийг заах тул “watch” орно; энэ үг үзэх, харж хамгаалах гэсэн утгаар бусад зайг ч нөхнө.
“Let's … a film tonight” гэсэн өгүүлбэрт кино үзэх гэсэн үйл үг хэрэгтэй тул “watch a film” (кино үзэх) хоршоо тохирно; “see” энд таарах ч бугуйн цаг гэсэн утгагүй.
“Could you … my bag for a minute” гэдэг нь цүнхийг түр харж хамгаалахыг хүсэж байгаа тул “watch” (хянах, харах) орно; “mind” энд таарах ч кино үзэх, бугуйн цаг гэсэн утгагүй.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Find the most suitable phrase for each situation. /2x1=2 points/

questions.stem: What will you wear to a job interview?
questions.explanation: Ажлын ярилцлагад цэвэрхэн, албан ёсны хувцас буюу “a smart suit” (костюм) өмсөнө; “pyjamas”, “slippers” нь гэрийн, “a swimsuit” усны хувцас.

questions.stem: What expression is used for *tricking someone as a joke*?

options.B: to play a trick on someone

questions.explanation: “to play a trick on someone” нь хэн нэгнийг шоглож хуурах гэсэн утгатай тул “tricking someone as a joke”-той таарна; “to play it safe” нь эрсдэлээс зайлсхийх.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct prefix and suffix that correspond to the following collocations. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem: A(n) ___ + understanding / spelled word / leading advertisement
questions.explanation: “understanding”, “spelled”, “leading” гурвуулаа буруу, алдаатай гэсэн утгатай “mis-” угтвар авч “misunderstanding” (үл ойлголцол), “misspelled” (буруу бичсэн), “misleading” (төөрөгдүүлсэн) болно.

questions.stem: A care(___) + driver / mistake / attitude
questions.explanation: “care” нэр үгэнд “-less” (…-гүй) дагавар залгаж “careless” (хайхрамжгүй) үүсэх ба жолооч, алдаа, хандлага гурвуулаатай нь хоршино; “careful mistake” гэж хэлдэггүй тул “-ful” таарахгүй.

tasks.title: Task 5
tasks.instructions: Fill in the correct preposition for each sentence. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem: She has applied ___ a job at the bank.
questions.explanation: Ажлын байранд өргөдөл гаргахыг “apply for a job” гэдэг тул “for” орно; “apply to” нь байгууллага руу хандахад хэрэглэгдэнэ.

questions.stem: This book was written ___ a famous journalist.
questions.explanation: Үйлдэгдэх хэвт (“was written”) үйлийг хэн хийснийг “by” угтвар үгээр заадаг тул ном “a famous journalist”-ийн бичсэн гэсэн утга гарна.

tasks.title: Task 6
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct meaning for each idiom underlined. /2x3=6 points/

questions.stem: He was so nervous in the interview that he <u>got his wires crossed</u> and answered the wrong question.
questions.explanation: “got his wires crossed” нь утас нь солигдсон мэт андуурч, буруу ойлгох гэсэн хэвшмэл хэллэг; “answered the wrong question” гэсэн нь “He misunderstood something.” гэдгийг батална.

questions.stem: My sister always <u>has her head in the clouds</u>.

options.B: She is a daydreamer and not very practical.

questions.explanation: “has her head in the clouds” нь үргэлж мөрөөдөлд автсан, бодит амьдралаас хөндий хүнийг хэлдэг хэвшмэл хэллэг тул “She is a daydreamer and not very practical.”

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the conversation from a job interview and answer the questions. /3x2=6 points/

questions.stem:
Part 1.
Interviewer: So, why do you want to work for our company?
Saraa: I've used your apps for years, and I'd love to help design them.
Interviewer: Have you done any design work before?
Saraa: Yes, I designed the website for my university's sports club.

What experience does Saraa have?

options.B: She has worked for the company before.
options.E: She designed a website for a sports club.

questions.explanation: Сараа “I designed the website for my university's sports club” гэж хариулсан тул түүний туршлага бол “She designed a website for a sports club.”

questions.stem:
Part 2.
Interviewer: The job involves working in a team. How do you deal with disagreements?
Saraa: I listen to everyone's ideas first, and then we try to find a solution together.

How does Saraa deal with disagreements?

options.A: She asks the manager to decide.
options.B: She always follows her own ideas.
options.C: She listens to everyone and looks for a shared solution.

questions.explanation: Сараа “I listen to everyone's ideas first, and then we try to find a solution together” гэсэн тул санал зөрөхөд бүгдийг сонсож, хамтын шийдэл хайдаг.

questions.stem:
Part 3.
Interviewer: When could you start?
Saraa: I finish my exams on the 20th of June, so I could start at the beginning of July.

When can Saraa start work?
questions.explanation: Сараа “I finish my exams on the 20th of June, so I could start at the beginning of July” гэсэн тул “At the beginning of July” ажилд орж чадна; 6-р сарын 20 бол шалгалт дуусах өдөр.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Read the conversations and fill in the missing phrasal verbs. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem:
A: The meeting starts at nine.
B: OK, I'll ___ at about quarter to.
questions.explanation: Уулзалт есөн цагт эхлэх тул “at about quarter to” буюу арван таван минутын өмнө ирнэ гэж байна; ирэх гэсэн утгатай нь “turn up”, харин “turn down” нь татгалзах.

questions.stem:
A: My bike has a flat tyre.
B: I'll help you ___ it ___.
questions.explanation: “My bike has a flat tyre” гэсэн тул хийгүй дугуйг насосоор хийлэхийг “pump up” гэдэг: зайнуудад “pump, up” орно; “blow out” нь үлээж унтраах.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the article and then answer the questions below. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text:
On 1 April 1957, viewers of Panorama, one of the most respected current affairs programmes on British television, saw an unusual report. It showed a family in southern Switzerland happily picking long strands of spaghetti from trees and laying them in the sun to dry.

The serious voice of the presenter explained that a mild winter had produced an excellent spaghetti crop that year. He even mentioned that a small insect, which had damaged spaghetti in the past, had almost disappeared. Everything looked and sounded like a real news report.

At that time, spaghetti was not a common food in Britain, and many people had never seen it uncooked. Hundreds of viewers phoned the BBC afterwards. Some asked whether the story was true; others wanted to know how they could grow their own spaghetti tree. According to a popular account, they were told to place a piece of spaghetti in a tin of tomato sauce and hope for the best.

Not everyone was amused. Some viewers complained that a serious programme should not be used for jokes. Most, however, enjoyed being fooled, and the report is now remembered as one of the greatest April Fool's Day jokes ever broadcast.

The story is often used today to show how easily people believe information when it comes from a trusted source. It reminds us that even a respected programme can, sometimes, be pulling our leg.

questions.stem: What is the article about?

options.D: The life of a television presenter
options.E: A famous April Fool's joke on television

questions.explanation: Өгүүлэл 1957 оны 4-р сарын 1-нд Британийн телевизээр гарсан спагетти модны тухай хуурамч мэдээний тухай тул “A famous April Fool's joke on television”.

questions.stem: Why did many British viewers believe the report?

options.B: Spaghetti was not common in Britain then, and the programme was respected.
options.D: They had read about it in newspapers.
options.E: The presenter said it was true news from Italy.

questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд нэвтрүүлгийг “one of the most respected current affairs programmes” гэж, 3-р догол мөрөнд “spaghetti was not a common food in Britain” гэж бичсэн; хоёр шалтгаан хоёулаа хариултад бий.

questions.stem: What does the article suggest about the BBC's answer to people who wanted to grow spaghetti?

options.D: It told them to visit Switzerland.

questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд спагетти тарихыг хүссэн хүмүүст “place a piece of spaghetti in a tin of tomato sauce and hope for the best” гэж хэлсэн нь “It continued the joke.” буюу шоглоомоо үргэлжлүүлснийг харуулна.

questions.stem: How did some viewers react?

options.C: They complained that a serious programme was used for a joke.

questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд “Some viewers complained that a serious programme should not be used for jokes” гэж бичсэн: зарим үзэгч ноцтой нэвтрүүлгийг тоглоомд ашигласанд дургүйцжээ.

questions.stem: What is the main lesson of the story, according to the last paragraph?

options.D: People easily believe information from a trusted source.

questions.explanation: Сүүлийн догол мөрөнд энэ түүх “how easily people believe information when it comes from a trusted source” болохыг харуулдаг гэжээ.

questions.stem: What is implied about most viewers' reactions?

options.D: The programme lost all its viewers.
options.E: Most viewers were amused rather than angry.

questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд “Most, however, enjoyed being fooled” гэж бичсэн тул ихэнх үзэгч уурлахын оронд хуурагдсандаа баясжээ; зөвхөн “Not everyone was amused”.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Read again and complete this summary of the article with the following words. There are two extra. /3x3=9 points/
tasks.text: In 1957, a BBC programme showed a family picking spaghetti from trees. Many viewers believed it 45. _________ spaghetti was not a common food in Britain at the time. 46. _________ some people complained, most viewers enjoyed the joke. The report was 47. _________ convincing that hundreds of people phoned the BBC.

questions.explanation: “spaghetti was not a common food in Britain at the time” гэсэн бүтэн өгүүлбэр үзэгчид итгэсний шалтгааныг заах тул “because” орно; “despite” нэр үгтэй хэрэглэгддэг.
“some people complained” ба “most viewers enjoyed the joke” гэсэн эсрэг санааг холбох тул “Although” (хэдийгээр … ч) орно; “despite” бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн өмнө ордоггүй.
Үр дагаврыг “so” + тэмдэг нэр + “that” бүтцээр илэрхийлдэг: мэдээ хэтэрхий үнэмшилтэй байсан болохоор “hundreds of people phoned the BBC”.

tasks.instructions: Read the passage and fill in the gaps with correct word forms. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text: Glaciers are huge masses of ice that move (a) _________ down mountains or across land. They form in places where more snow falls in winter than (b) _________ in summer. Over many years, the snow is pressed into thick, solid ice. Although glaciers seem to stand still, most move between a few centimetres and a few metres every day. As they slide, they (c) _________ rocks with them and carve deep valleys. Glaciers and ice sheets store about two-thirds of the world's fresh water, and millions of people (d) _________ on glacier meltwater for drinking and farming. Today, however, most glaciers are (e) _________ because of rising temperatures, and scientists are (f) _________ about the future water supply in many regions.

gaps.label: a
gaps.explanation: “move” үйл үгийг хэрхэн хөдөлдгийг тодотгож байгаа тул дайвар үг “slowly” (удаанаар) орно; “slow”, “slower” нь тэмдэг нэр.

gaps.label: b
gaps.explanation: “more snow falls in winter than … in summer” гэж харьцуулж байгаа тул “falls”-тай зэрэгцэх одоо энгийн цагийн ганц тооны үйл үг “melts” (хайлдаг) орно.

gaps.label: c
gaps.explanation: Өгүүлэгдэхүүн “they”-ийн дараа одоо энгийн цагийн үйл үг хэрэгтэй тул “carry” орж мөсөн гол чулууг дагуулан зөөдөг гэсэн утга гарна; “carried” өнгөрсөн цаг, “carrier” нэр үг.

gaps.label: d
gaps.explanation: “millions of people … on glacier meltwater” гэсэн өгүүлбэрт үйл үг хэрэгтэй бөгөөд “depend on” (…-аас хамаарах) хэллэг үүсэх тул “depend”; “dependent” нь тэмдэг нэр.

gaps.label: e
gaps.explanation: “are … because of rising temperatures” хэсэгт одоо үргэлжилж буй цаг үүсгэх -ing хэлбэр хэрэгтэй тул “shrinking” (багасаж байна); “shrank” нь өнгөрсөн цаг.

gaps.label: f
gaps.explanation: “be concerned about” (…-д санаа зовох) хэллэгт тэмдэг нэрийн үүрэгтэй “concerned” орно; “concerning” нь …-ийн тухай гэсэн угтвар үг, “concernedly” нь дайвар үг.

tasks.instructions: Read the passage in 2.1 again and match the words (a-h) to their definitions. There are two extra. The tenth definition is numbered 0. /8x1=8 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: “mass” нь “a large amount of a substance without a clear shape”; эхэд мөсөн голыг асар том мөсний бөөгнөрөл гэж тодорхойлсон.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “to press” (дарах, шахах) нь “to push firmly against something”; олон жилийн туршид цас дарагдаж зузаан мөс болдог.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “solid” (хатуу, нягт) нь “hard and firm, not liquid or gas”; цас шахагдсаар зузаан, хатуу мөс болдог гэж эхэд бичсэн.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “to slide” (гулсах) нь “to move smoothly over a surface”; мөсөн гол гулсан хөдлөхдөө чулуу зөөж, хөндий сийлдэг.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “to carve” (сийлэх, зүсэх) нь “to cut a shape into a hard material”; мөсөн гол хатуу чулуулгийг зүсэж гүн хөндий үүсгэдэг.

items.label: f
items.explanation: “fresh water” (цэнгэг ус) нь “water that is not salty”, өөрөөр хэлбэл далайн давстай уснаас ялгаатай ус; дэлхийн цэнгэг усны гуравны хоёр мөсөнд хадгалагддаг.

items.label: g
items.explanation: “to store” (хадгалах, нөөцлөх) нь “to keep something so that you can use it later”; мөсөн гол цэнгэг усыг ирээдүйн хэрэглээнд хадгалдаг.

items.label: h
items.explanation: “region” (бүс нутаг) нь “an area of a country or of the world”; эхэд олон бүс нутгийн ирээдүйн усны хангамжид эрдэмтэд санаа зовж байна гэжээ.

choices.text: to cut a shape into a hard material
an area of a country or of the world
to move smoothly over a surface
a large amount of a substance without a clear shape
hard and firm, not liquid or gas
to keep something so that you can use it later

tasks.instructions: Read the short passage and find the SYNONYM of the word in bold. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text: Before a job interview, it is (a) **vital** to find out about the company. On the day, try to arrive (b) **punctually** and dress (c) **appropriately**. During the interview, answer questions (d) **honestly** and keep your answers (e) **concise**. Finally, (f) **demonstrate** that you are enthusiastic about the job.

gaps.label: a
gaps.explanation: Компанийн талаар судлах нь зайлшгүй чухал гэсэн утгаар “vital” хэрэглэгдсэн тул ойролцоо утгатай үг нь “essential”; “optional” (заавал биш) бол эсрэг утга.

gaps.label: b
gaps.explanation: “punctually” нь ярилцлагад яг товлосон цагтаа ирэх гэсэн утгатай тул “on time”-тай ижил; “late” (хоцорч) нь эсрэг утгатай.

gaps.label: c
gaps.explanation: “appropriately” нь нөхцөл байдалд зохистой гэсэн утгатай тул “suitably”-тай ижил; “strangely” (хачин), “carelessly” (хайхрамжгүй) ярилцлагын хувцаслалтад тохирохгүй.

gaps.label: d
gaps.explanation: Асуултад “honestly” хариулах нь худал хэлэлгүй, үнэнээр хариулах гэсэн утгатай тул ойролцоо үг нь “truthfully”; “rudely” (бүдүүлгээр), “shyly” (ичингүйрэн) өөр утгатай.

gaps.label: e
gaps.explanation: “keep your answers” гэсний дараах “concise” нь товч бөгөөд ойлгомжтой гэсэн утгатай тул “short and clear”; “long and detailed” бол эсрэг утга.

gaps.label: f
gaps.explanation: “demonstrate that you are enthusiastic” нь урам зоригтой гэдгээ харуулах гэсэн утгатай тул “demonstrate” нь “show”; “hide” (нуух), “deny” (үгүйсгэх) нь эсрэг утгатай.
